decisions.reason: Accepting the referenced bowl size does not change the existing requirement for high-quality mixing and consistent foam.
The bowl-size decision supplies a design parameter but does not change the system-layout deliverable or its existing design direction.
The accepted bowl size does not alter the independently established requirement for quick bowl removal and swapping.
The source decision confirms bowl size without changing the splash-control target.
Neither bowl-size acceptance nor the separate beige-color clause changes the machine name or placard wording.
The accepted bowl size does not necessarily change the spout location, orientation, pouring goal, or design reference.
The beige-color decision is a separate clause already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the bowl-size modification requires no additional color event.
Confirming the bowl size and selecting beige do not replace or otherwise change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The bowl-size decision does not modify the requirement to produce a basic wiring plan.
Accepting a bowl size does not change the existing leak-prevention requirements for the bowl, base, or electronics.
The bowl-size decision does not alter the valve mechanism, no-drip behavior, or controlled-flow requirement.
The accepted bowl size does not change the spout cleaning requirement or prescribed cleaning methods.
